Class SceneNavigator

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.controller.SceneNavigator
public class SceneNavigator extends Object
Responsible for switching scenes (main menu, leaderboard, game, etc.). Centralized navigation handler to avoid duplicate navigation logic.
